rules.title: Writ AST node kinds
rules.statement: A Writ value parses to exactly one node kind from the closed set { MAP, ARRAY, STRING, INTEGER, FLOAT, BOOLEAN, NULL_VAL, TYPED_VALUE, DATATYPE, MAP_ENTRY, PARAM_VAL }. Each node carries a CODE field equal to its kind code.

rules.title: TYPED_VALUE node
rules.statement: A TYPED_VALUE node represents a typename-applied-to-value construction of the form Typename(value), e.g. Date("2026-01-01").

rules.title: DATATYPE node
rules.statement: A DATATYPE node represents a type name with optional generic parameters of the form Typename<Param, ...>.
